description: React component for managing requests, including viewing, editing status and assignment, closing requests, and quick reassign helper.

methods.name: statusPill
methods.description: Returns a styled span element representing the status label with color coding.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches requests and users data, initializes state for editing.

methods.description: Saves updates to a request's status and assigned mechanic.

methods.name: submit
